case_name: Younge v. Fulton Judicial Circuit District Attorney’s Office
title: 42 U.S.C. § 2000e(f) — who is an “employee”
status: historical trial design, not approval or source evidence

cue.heading: 42 U.S.C. § 2000e(f) — who is an “employee”
cue.text: The term “employee” means an individual employed by an employer, except that the term “employee” shall not include any person elected to public office … or <mark>any person chosen by such officer to be on such officer's personal staff</mark>, or an appointee on the policy making level or an immediate adviser with respect to the exercise of the constitutional or legal powers of the office.
